units.title: The physically literate individual will demonstrate competency in a variety of motor skills and movement patterns

subtopics.title: Locomotor (Hopping, galloping, running, sliding, skipping, leaping, walking, running)

outcomes.text: Performs emerging patterns in locomotor skills (walk, run, leap, hop, gallop, slide, and skip) while maintaining balance (such as when you hear the color of your shirt leap over a pillow).
Perform mature patterns in locomotor skills (walk).

outcomes.text: Performs jumping and landing actions with balance (such as when you hear the color of your shirt, jump over a line on the floor).

Performs emerging patterns in nonlocomotor skills (such as bend, twist, turn, sway, stretch) in exploratory and a stable environment.

Developmentally appropriate/emerging outcomes first appear in grade one.
Throws underhand and overhand with opposite foot forward demonstrating an emerging pattern.
Developmentally appropriate/emerging outcomes first appear in grade four.
Drops a ball and catches it before it bounces twice.

Soft taps a ball using the inside of the foot, sending it forward.
Performs emerging pattern while receiving with the preferred foot when stationary.
Volley a lightweight object (such as a balloon), sending it upward with an open palm.
Strikes a lightweight object with a paddle or short-handled racket
Practices single and group jump roping frequently after watching the activities modeled for them.
